title: אמימר בריה דמר ינוקא

paragraphs: Amemar, son of Mar Yenuka, son of Rav Chisda the priest (see there). Before Rabbi Chiyya son of Rav Avya, Chullin 18, end of b. Killed by Persia’s king; see part I, 4234. Amemar intended to establish it in Nehardea; Rav Ashi told him, etc., Berakhot 12a. He instituted in Nehardea, Sukkah 55, end of a. A woman summoned to his court there failed to follow when he went to Mechoza; he issued a writ against her. Rav Ashi spoke, Rosh Hashanah 31b. Nehardeans say, etc.; “I am a Nehardean and hold thus,” Bava Metzia 35a; Bava Batra 31a. Acha bar Rava (so should be read) told Ravina Amemar visited and expounded; “Nehardeans follow their position,” Bava Batra 124, end of b. Ravnai, Chiyya bar Abba’s brother, came with a Shmuel teaching. Amemar praised it. Rav Ashi: “Because your maternal grandfather [Rami bar Chama, according to Heilprin’s gloss] praised it, do you? Rava refuted it,” Ketubbot 21b. Amemar, Mar Zutra, and Rav Ashi sat at Persian King Azgur’s gate; see there. Mar Zushra [זושרא] to Ashi, Ellu Tereifot. Rav Ashi said to Mar bar Amemar, “If he dies” [your father, who is pious]. This was like an inadvertent utterance from a ruler [Rav Ashi], and Amemar died. [Bava Metzia 68a] He permitted Huna bar Natan to marry a Mechozan; Ashi spoke, Kiddushin 72b. Ashi before him, Menachot 37b, asked him and called him master, Beitzah 22a. In Rav Zevid’s name, Chullin 76b. Tosafot, Hamatznia 93a: Amemar was far later than Rava, even Pappa his student; perhaps after Amemar’s case, Rav Zevid heard the teaching in Rava’s name rather than from Rava himself. Difficult: Acha bar Rava said Amemar visited. Amemar: Pumbedita’s elders told me, Eruvin 80, beginning of a; Maharshal deletes “Amemar said.” Rav Sheshet asked him, “Are you particular about the vessel?” Difficult, Amemar much later. Yuchasin separates an entry: “Amemar, addressed by Sheshet; I am of Nehardea’s elders; a judge. Amemar, Rami bar Chama’s daughter’s son (see there), addressed by Ashi; perhaps this is the one saying I am of Nehardea’s elders; Amemar and Mar Zutra,” etc. End quotation. I do not know why he separated them. Rav Acha bar Abba. Rav Acha bar Rava stood over them. Ashi, his student. Rav Gamda spoke to him. In Dimi of Nehardea’s name; Zevid’s name, Chullin; Zevid of Nehardea. In Rav Chama’s name, Ketubbot 86a. Rav Yeimar and Minyomi bar Rechumi before him; Mordekhai spoke to him. Marimar said in Nachman’s name, Chullin 45b. In Pappa’s name, Chullin 8, end of b. Ravina in his name. In Rava’s name, Chullin 46, end of b. Sheshet spoke to him; see above.
